hours: We are open Monday to Friday, 7:30 AM to 5:00 PM, and Saturday 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM. We are closed on Sunday.
appointment required: Most services require an appointment. Please call ahead or use our online scheduler to book a time.
walk in: Walk‑ins are welcome during business hours. Same‑day service may be possible, but most walk‑ins will require leaving the car overnight. A loaner vehicle can be provided if needed.
loaner vehicle: Yes, we can provide a loaner vehicle if your car needs to stay overnight. Please ask when you drop off your car.
oil change: An oil change costs $49.95 and takes about 30 minutes. Walk‑ins are welcome, but an appointment guarantees a shorter wait.
battery: A new battery costs $299, including installation. Appointment recommended.
transmission fluid: Transmission fluid service costs $249. Appointment required.
power steering fluid: Power steering fluid service costs $1000. Appointment required.
labor rate: Our labor rate is $235 per hour.
tire rotation: Tire rotation costs $29.95 and takes about 20 minutes. Appointment recommended.
brake inspection: A brake inspection is free and takes about 15 minutes. Appointment required.
phone: You can reach our service desk at (555) 123-4567.
schedule appointment: To schedule an appointment, please tell me your preferred date and time. I'll check availability and book it for you.
